results.title: NAIMOS arrests 28 in Akango galamsey raid, destroys 29 chanfang machines
results.snippet: NAIMOS held about 195 people at an illegal mining site at Akango in Nzema East, arrested 28 suspected foremen and machine owners and destroyed 29 chanfangs.
